title: RankedProduct
description: A WooCommerce product card as returned from the cloud, extended with AI ranking fields. All inferred fields carry source, confidence, updated_at and approval_state. Base fields mirror class-asc-search.php:format_product.

permalink.description: Canonical product URL on the store.

image.description: Thumbnail image URL. Never a data URI or model-invented URL.

price_html.description: WooCommerce-formatted price HTML. Never modified by AI — price is set by WooCommerce only.

add_to_cart_url.description: WC Store API cart endpoint. Always /wp-json/wc/store/v1/cart/add-item. Never model-generated or modified.

attributes.description: Variable product attribute list. Present only when type=variable.

variations.description: Variable product variants. Capped at 20. Present only when type=variable.

ai_rank.description: 1-based position in the AI-ranked result set. 0 = not AI-ranked (provisional source or ranking unavailable).

ai_reason.description: Brief explanation of ranking. DEVELOPER/DEBUG MODE ONLY — never displayed to shoppers.

suggest_qty.description: Advisory quantity for the query context (e.g. 2 packs for 5 servings). Never pre-filled in cart — user controls actual quantity.

inferred_attrs.description: AI-inferred product attributes (allergens, origin, dietary flags). Each entry carries full provenance. review_required=true when approval_state=pending.

approval_state.description: Allergen and origin fields must reach approved before being displayed without a caveat. pending → review_required:true → caveat label shown. rejected → field hidden.

review_required.description: Computed from approval_state: true when pending. MUST be true for all safety-critical inferred attributes.
